description.zh-CN: 控制台和管理接口绑定的网卡地址。未设置时跟随“局域网管理访问”：关闭为 127.0.0.1，开启为 0.0.0.0。
description.en-US: The network address the console and admin APIs bind to. When unset it follows "LAN admin access": 127.0.0.1 when off, 0.0.0.0 when on.

description.zh-CN: 控制台、管理接口和本机网关使用的端口。修改后需要重启入口服务，MCP 和联网搜索重启后也会改用新端口。
description.en-US: The port of the console, the admin APIs and the local gateway. A change needs an entry restart, and MCP and web search switch to the new port when they restart.

description.zh-CN: 让局域网设备通过本机 IP 打开控制台。写操作仍需先配对设备，模型接口需要 API Key。
description.en-US: Let devices on your LAN open the console through this machine's IP. Changes still need a paired device, and model APIs need an API key.

description.zh-CN: 运行独立的公网监听端口，供 cloudflared 或 Caddy 转发。关闭后公网门户和公网 API 都不可用。
description.en-US: Run the separate public listener that cloudflared or Caddy forwards to. When off, the public portal and the public API are unavailable.

description.zh-CN: 公网监听端口绑定的网卡地址。未设置时跟随“局域网直连公网端口”：关闭为 127.0.0.1，开启为 0.0.0.0。
description.en-US: The network address the public listener binds to. When unset it follows "LAN access to the public port": 127.0.0.1 when off, 0.0.0.0 when on.

description.zh-CN: 隧道或反向代理转发到的本机端口。
description.en-US: The local port your tunnel or reverse proxy forwards to.

title.en-US: LAN access to the public port

description.zh-CN: 让局域网设备通过本机 IP 直接调用公网端口上的模型接口，仍然需要 API Key。
description.en-US: Let LAN devices call the model APIs on the public port through this machine's IP. An API key is still required.

description.zh-CN: 外部用户访问本服务的 https 地址，例如隧道域名。留空表示只在局域网内使用。
description.en-US: The https address outside users reach this service at, such as your tunnel domain. Leave it empty to use the service on your LAN only.

description.zh-CN: 首次启动后的一段时间内，本机浏览器打开控制台即成为管理员，无需输入配对码。
description.en-US: For a short time after the first start, a browser on this machine that opens the console becomes the owner without a pairing code.

description.zh-CN: 首次启动后允许自动配对的分钟数。
description.en-US: How many minutes after the first start automatic pairing stays possible.

description.zh-CN: 已配对的浏览器保持管理员登录的天数。
description.en-US: How many days a paired browser stays signed in as the owner.

title.en-US: View without signing in on this machine

description.zh-CN: 本机浏览器无需登录即可查看状态（只读），修改设置仍需管理员登录。
description.en-US: Browsers on this machine can view status without signing in (read only). Changing settings still needs the owner session.

title.en-US: View without signing in on the LAN

description.zh-CN: 局域网设备无需登录即可查看脱敏后的状态（只读）。
description.en-US: LAN devices can view redacted status without signing in (read only).

title.en-US: Allow the owner on the LAN

description.zh-CN: 允许已配对的局域网设备执行管理操作。关闭时局域网设备只能查看。
description.en-US: Let paired LAN devices make changes. When off, LAN devices can only view.

title.zh-CN: 经代理到达控制台端口的网关请求
title.en-US: Proxied gateway requests on the console port

description.zh-CN: 经反向代理到达控制台端口的 /gateway 请求如何处理：serve 继续服务但必须带 API Key，reject 要求客户端改用公网监听端口。
description.en-US: How /gateway requests that reach the console port through a reverse proxy are handled: serve keeps answering them with an API key required, reject tells clients to use the public listener.

title.zh-CN: 本机网关每分钟请求上限

description.zh-CN: 未带 API Key 的本机或局域网 /gateway 调用方每分钟最多可发送的请求数。
description.en-US: How many requests per minute a /gateway caller on this machine or the LAN may send without an API key.

title.zh-CN: 额外允许的控制台主机名

description.zh-CN: 除本机地址外，允许用这些主机名打开控制台，例如局域网内的自定义名称。
description.en-US: Host names besides the local addresses that may open the console, such as a custom name on your LAN.

description.zh-CN: 只有来自这些地址段的请求才会采信转发头中的客户端 IP，通常保持本机地址即可。
description.en-US: Forwarded client IP headers are believed only from these address ranges. Keeping the local addresses is usually right.

title.zh-CN: 客户端 IP 请求头

description.zh-CN: 可信代理用来传递真实客户端 IP 的请求头，Cloudflare 隧道使用 cf-connecting-ip。
description.en-US: The header a trusted proxy uses to pass the real client IP. Cloudflare tunnels use cf-connecting-ip.

description.zh-CN: 可信代理用来传递客户端国家或地区代码的请求头，用于统计；留空表示不读取。
description.en-US: The header a trusted proxy uses to pass the client's country code, used in statistics. Leave it empty to ignore it.

title.zh-CN: 网关 API Key 要求

description.zh-CN: 控制台端口上的 /gateway 何时需要 API Key：auto 表示局域网需要、本机可选，on 表示总是需要，off 表示从不需要。公网监听端口始终需要 API Key。
description.en-US: When /gateway on the console port needs an API key: auto requires one from the LAN and makes it optional on this machine, on always requires one, off never does. The public listener always requires a key.

description.zh-CN: 允许这些网页来源（协议、主机和端口）在浏览器中直接调用本机网关，不携带登录凭据。留空表示不允许跨域调用。
description.en-US: Web pages from these origins (scheme, host and port) may call the local gateway from a browser, without credentials. Leave it empty to refuse cross-origin calls.

description.zh-CN: vLLM 和 llama.cpp 管理器绑定的地址。默认只监听本机，局域网通过控制台访问；设为 0.0.0.0 可让局域网设备直接打开旧版管理器页面。
description.en-US: The address both model managers bind to. By default they listen on this machine only and the LAN goes through the console; set 0.0.0.0 to let LAN devices open the legacy manager pages directly.

description.zh-CN: 单独设置 vLLM / SGLang 管理器的监听地址；未设置时跟随“管理器监听地址”。
description.en-US: Sets the listen address of the vLLM / SGLang manager on its own. When unset it follows "Manager listen address".

description.zh-CN: vLLM / SGLang 管理器的端口。入口服务和 MCP 重启后会改用新端口。
description.en-US: The port of the vLLM / SGLang manager. The entry and MCP switch to the new port when they restart.

description.zh-CN: 单独设置 llama.cpp 管理器的监听地址；未设置时跟随“管理器监听地址”。
description.en-US: Sets the listen address of the llama.cpp manager on its own. When unset it follows "Manager listen address".

description.zh-CN: llama.cpp 管理器的端口。入口服务和 MCP 重启后会改用新端口。
description.en-US: The port of the llama.cpp manager. The entry and MCP switch to the new port when they restart.

title.zh-CN: 启动时的 Docker 处理

description.zh-CN: 启动平台时 Docker 未运行怎么办：start 自动启动 Docker Desktop 并等待，wait 只等待不启动，off 不等待。
description.en-US: What platform start does when Docker is not running: start launches Docker Desktop and waits, wait only waits, off does not wait.

description.zh-CN: Docker Desktop.exe 的完整路径。留空时自动查找默认安装位置。
description.en-US: The full path of Docker Desktop.exe. Leave it empty to use the default install location.

description.zh-CN: 填写 WSL 发行版名称后，管理器用该发行版里的 docker 命令运行容器，而不是 Docker Desktop。留空使用 Docker Desktop。
description.en-US: With a WSL distribution name, the managers run containers with the docker command inside that distribution instead of Docker Desktop. Leave it empty to use Docker Desktop.

description.zh-CN: 启动平台时最多等待 Docker 引擎就绪的秒数。
description.en-US: How many seconds platform start waits at most for the Docker engine to become ready.

description.zh-CN: 打开控制台根地址时显示哪个界面：classic 为经典控制台，new 为新版控制台。
description.en-US: Which console opens at the root address: classic is the current console, new is the redesigned one.

description.zh-CN: platform start 完成后自动在浏览器中打开控制台。
description.en-US: Open the console in your browser when platform start finishes.

description.zh-CN: platform 命令输出所用的语言；auto 跟随系统语言。
description.en-US: The language of platform command output. auto follows the system language.

description.zh-CN: 本机 MCP 服务的端口，只监听本机。
description.en-US: The port of the local MCP server, which listens on this machine only.

description.zh-CN: 向 MCP 客户端提供哪些工具：all 为全部，ops 只有本机平台工具，web 只有搜索和网页工具。
description.en-US: Which tools MCP clients get: all of them, ops (local platform tools only) or web (search and web page tools only).

description.zh-CN: compact 只声明外层结构和字段名，full 提供完整的 JSON Schema，供需要校验的客户端使用。
description.en-US: compact declares the envelope and the field names only; full advertises the complete JSON Schema for clients that validate.

description.zh-CN: MCP 客户端每分钟最多可发起的联网搜索次数。
description.en-US: How many web searches MCP clients may run per minute.

title.zh-CN: MCP 每分钟本机查询次数

description.zh-CN: MCP 客户端每分钟最多可发起的本机平台查询次数。
description.en-US: How many local platform reads MCP clients may make per minute.

description.zh-CN: 相同的管理器查询在这段时间内只发送一次；0 表示不缓存。
description.en-US: Identical manager reads within this window are sent once; 0 turns the cache off.

description.zh-CN: MCP 客户端连接时使用的密钥。首次启动时自动生成，只保存在加密的密钥库中，不会写入配置文件。
description.en-US: The key MCP clients connect with. It is generated on first start and kept only in the encrypted secret store, never in the config file.

description.zh-CN: 语音合成网关的本机端口，入口服务把 /gateway/tts 转发到这里。
description.en-US: The local port of the text-to-speech gateway, which the entry forwards /gateway/tts to.

description.zh-CN: 入口服务调用语音网关时携带的密钥，只保存在加密的密钥库中。
description.en-US: The key the entry presents to the TTS gateway, kept only in the encrypted secret store.

description.zh-CN: 联网搜索网关的本机端口。
description.en-US: The local port of the web search gateway.

description.zh-CN: 搜索网关调用本地模型时使用的 OpenAI 兼容地址。留空时自动选择：优先公网监听端口，其次控制台的局域网地址。
description.en-US: The OpenAI-compatible address the search gateway calls for models. Leave it empty to choose automatically: the public listener first, then the console's LAN address.

description.zh-CN: 入口服务和 MCP 调用搜索网关时使用的密钥，只保存在加密的密钥库中。
description.en-US: The key the entry and MCP use to call the search gateway, kept only in the encrypted secret store.

description.zh-CN: 搜索网关调用本地模型时携带的 API Key，只保存在加密的密钥库中。
description.en-US: The API key the search gateway presents when it calls local models, kept only in the encrypted secret store.

description.zh-CN: 下载模型时 Hugging Face 工具使用的缓存目录。
description.en-US: The cache folder the Hugging Face tools use while downloading models.

description.zh-CN: 语音合成的 Python 环境和模型所在目录。留空使用安装脚本的默认位置。
description.en-US: Where the text-to-speech Python environments and models live. Leave it empty to use the install script's default.

description.zh-CN: 下载受限模型时使用的令牌。只有下载时勾选“记住”才会保存，并且只存放在加密的密钥库中。
description.en-US: The token used for gated model downloads. It is stored only when you tick "remember" during a download, and only in the encrypted secret store.

description.zh-CN: 登录 Windows 后守护进程启动哪组组件：core 为入口和两个管理器，full 另加 MCP、语音和搜索，none 只启动守护进程。
description.en-US: Which components the supervisor starts after you sign in to Windows: core is the entry and both managers, full adds MCP, TTS and search, none starts only the supervisor.

description.zh-CN: 守护进程重启后如何处理之前运行的模型：off 不处理，offer 在控制台提示恢复，auto 自动以新增方式恢复，从不替换正在运行的容器。
description.en-US: What the supervisor does with models that ran before a restart: off does nothing, offer suggests restoring them in the console, auto restores them as additions and never replaces a running container.

description.zh-CN: 组件崩溃后，在统计窗口内最多自动重启的次数；超过后标记为失败。
description.en-US: How many times a crashed component is restarted within the window before it is marked failed.

description.zh-CN: 统计自动重启次数所用的时间窗口。
description.en-US: The time window that automatic restarts are counted in.

title.zh-CN: 单个日志大小上限（字节）

description.zh-CN: 组件日志超过这个大小后轮转为新文件。
description.en-US: A component log rotates to a new file once it grows past this size.

description.zh-CN: 每个组件保留的已轮转日志份数。
description.en-US: How many rotated logs each component keeps.

description.zh-CN: 组件失败或需要处理时显示 Windows 桌面通知。
description.en-US: Show a Windows desktop notification when a component fails or needs attention.

title.zh-CN: 平台目录最低剩余空间（GB）
title.en-US: Minimum free space for the platform folder (GB)

description.zh-CN: 平台所在磁盘的剩余空间低于该值时，健康检查给出警告。
description.en-US: The health check warns when the drive holding the platform has less free space than this.

title.zh-CN: 模型目录最低剩余空间（GB）
title.en-US: Minimum free space for model folders (GB)

description.zh-CN: 任一模型目录所在磁盘的剩余空间低于该值时，健康检查给出警告。
description.en-US: The health check warns when a drive holding a model folder has less free space than this.

title.zh-CN: Docker 数据最低剩余空间（GB）
title.en-US: Minimum free space for Docker data (GB)

description.zh-CN: Docker 数据所在磁盘的剩余空间低于该值时，健康检查给出警告。
description.en-US: The health check warns when the drive holding Docker data has less free space than this.

description.zh-CN: WSL 可用内存低于该值时健康检查给出警告，因为大模型可能无法加载。
description.en-US: The health check warns when WSL has less memory than this, because large models may fail to load.

description.zh-CN: 检查更新时用来比较的 Git 分支。
description.en-US: The Git branch that update checks compare against.

description.zh-CN: 按组件 id 覆盖自动启动、所属配置组、重启策略、附加环境变量或启动参数，例如让语音工作进程随平台一起启动。
description.en-US: Per component id, override autostart, profile, restart policy, extra environment variables or launch arguments, for example to start the TTS workers with the platform.
